abstract: Primary mediastinal yolk sac tumors (YSTs) are rare and have a high degree of malignancy. This article reports a 42-year-old man with a primary mediastinal YST. The patient presented with chest tightness and shortness of breath. Using a contrast-enhanced computer tomography (CT) scan, the mediastinal space was found to be occupied by a mass shadow, about 10 cm × 8 cm with a clear boundary and low density. Serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) was elevated to 7169.66 ng/ml. The 5th day after hospitalization, a percutaneous biopsy of the mediastinal mass was performed. Malignant tumor cells were found by cytologic examination. According to the pathological morphology and immunohistochemical results, the tumor was diagnosed as primary mediastinal YST. Subsequently, the patient underwent five cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy including bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (BEP) and surgical tumor removal. One month after operation, AFP was elevated to 252.96 ng/ml. CT examination showed that the tumor recurred. As of September 12, 2020, the patient has undergone four cycles of VIP (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin) chemotherapy after relapse, and the patient's condition is currently in partial remission.
abstract_ja: 原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍(YST)は稀であり、悪性度が高い。本稿では、原発性縦隔YSTを発症した42歳男性について報告する。患者は胸部圧迫感と息切れを呈した。造影CT検査で、縦隔に境界明瞭で低濃度の約10cm×8cmの腫瘤影を認めた。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は7169.66ng/mlに上昇していた。入院5日目に縦隔腫瘤の経皮的生検を行った。細胞学的検査で悪性腫瘍細胞を認めた。病理形態学的所見および免疫組織化学的結果に基づき、原発性縦隔YSTと診断された。その後、患者はブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンからなるBEP療法による化学療法を5コース受けるとともに、外科的腫瘍切除を受けた。術後1か月でAFPは252.96ng/mlに上昇した。CT検査で腫瘍の再発が認められた。2020年9月12日時点で、患者は再発後にVIP療法(エトポシド、イホスファミド、シスプラチン)による化学療法を4コース受けており、現在は部分寛解の状態である。
